reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Read-only views of the live scope, worked out fresh each time you open them.
reports.matrix.intro: How each business area is answered, by kind of solution. A cell shows the solutions answering that area's requirements and how many requirements they answer. A solution answering two areas counts in both.
reports.matrix.shareNote: Technology solutions as a share of live solutions (rejected ones left out).
reports.cov.intro: Where the scope has gaps: requirements with nothing behind them, and things nothing asks for. Warnings need a look; information lines can be legal.
reports.cov.br_without_output_de.note: No data entity is created, updated or deleted by these requirements.
reports.cov.br_without_solution.note: No solution answers these requirements (a rejected solution does not count).
reports.cov.br_without_fr: Business requirements with no function requirement
reports.cov.br_without_fr.note: Allowed — a requirement can be met without software.
reports.cov.fr_without_br: Function requirements traced to no business requirement
reports.cov.fr_without_br.note: Nothing in the business scope asks for these.
reports.cov.fr_without_solution.note: These carry no solution tag yet.
reports.cov.fr_solution_outside_its_brs: Solution tag outside the FR's business requirements
The tagged solution answers none of the requirements the FR is linked to.
The FR's solution answers this requirement, but the FR is not linked to it. A hint only.
reports.cov.flow_uncovered.note: No linked interface FR carries this entity between these two systems.
reports.cov.fr_rejected_tag: Function requirements tagged to a rejected solution
reports.cov.tech_solution_without_fr: Technology and data solutions with no function requirement
reports.cov.tech_solution_without_fr.not: These answer a requirement but no function requirement describes what to build.
reports.cov.de_unreferenced.note: No business requirement reads or writes these — check whether they are in scope.
reports.off: This part needs the {component} component, which is off for this project.
reports.trace.intro: Every function requirement under each business requirement it answers, step by step. An FR linked to three BRs shows three times.
reports.trace.empty: No function requirement is linked to a business requirement yet.
reports.trace.notThisBr: Not a solution of this BR
reports.trace.untracedNote: These FRs answer no business requirement yet. A solution tag alone does not trace an FR.
reports.trace.withoutNote: Solutions that answer a business requirement and need no function requirement (people, process and the like).
reports.gap.intro: The migration backlog, system by system. As-is and to-be areas are compared only where their chart code and name agree; a system counts as today's support only when it is as-is or both.
reports.gap.nothingRecorded: No as-is support is recorded yet, so the gap below cannot be read as "no gap".
reports.gap.unallocated: Supported today, not allocated in the to-be area
reports.gap.unallocatedNote: Each system supporting an as-is step that no to-be step of the same area is allocated to — nothing replaces it there.
reports.gap.unsupported: Allocated in the to-be area, not there today
reports.gap.unsupportedNote: Each system allocated to a to-be step that supports no as-is step of the same area — new capability.
reports.gap.retiringNote: Systems supporting an as-is step that no solution answering a live requirement allocates, anywhere.
reports.gap.byToBe: To-be systems linked as today's support
reports.gap.byToBeNote: Information only: a to-be system is never counted as today's support.
reports.gap.unmatchedNote: Areas whose code and name do not agree across the two charts, with the reason.
reports.print.failed: The report could not be prepared for printing
reports.print.useButton: Use Print / PDF to print this report.
reports.volatility.intro: Each future-state area across every pair of consecutive baselines. An area is marked when one of its business requirements was added, changed or removed, or when requirements moved in or out of it. A re-order alone is not a change.
reports.volatility.runNote: Freezes in a row, up to the latest, in which one area changed
reports.migration.intro: Every data entity the future state uses: the systems holding it today and the systems it goes to. An entity with no system today, or held by two or more, needs a data-ownership decision before design freeze.
reports.migration.notSeenNote: New data, or not mapped yet
reports.migration.newDataNote: Not counted: new data, or the as-is mapping has not reached them yet.
reports.migration.retiring: Used today, not in the future state
reports.migration.retiringNote: Not counted: an archive question rather than a migration one.
reports.impact.intro: Each org unit and the share of the changes one of its roles is responsible or accountable for, on the future-state RACI. A change is a future-state requirement with a live solution that is not rejected. Consulted and informed roles hear about a change but do not absorb it, so they are shown and not counted.
reports.impact.withoutRa: {n} with no responsible or accountable role yet
reports.impact.note: Today's RACI is shown for context only: today's and the future processes are not linked step to step, so it cannot say which of today's roles a change touches.
reports.engagement.intro: Each org unit on a change and whether it has a voice: a stakeholder in it, or in the unit directly above it, has raised an issue (open or closed). A heavily affected unit that has said nothing is an adoption risk.
reports.engagement.allHeard: Every affected unit has a voice
reports.engagement.raisedCell: {own} by the unit · {parent} by the unit above
